references.source: Avfall Sverige. 2022. “Swedish Waste Management 2022.” [Avfall Sverige. 2022. "Svensk Avfallshantering."]
references.notes: The data was obtained from Avfall Web's municipal section and shows which treatment method was applied to the collected household waste. 'We use the term household waste to refer to the waste generated by households and businesses that falls under municipal waste responsibility pursuant to Chapter 15, § 20 of the Swedish Environmental Code. Compared with the concept of municipal waste, construction and demolition waste from households is included, while waste from park and street maintenance is not included. Food waste includes home compost and waste from food waste disposers sent to the sewer system.' Therefore, 'recycling from construction material' has not been included.
